# Grand Funding LLC

Grand Funding LLC provides business-purpose real estate loans to real estate investors in Arizona and California. Business-purpose loans for real estate investors only. Not for owner-occupied or consumer purposes. Credit, income, experience, and documentation requirements are determined after review of the specific transaction.

## Key Facts

- Loan purpose: business-purpose loans for real estate investors only; not for owner-occupied or consumer purposes
- Service area: statewide in Arizona and California
- Rates, points, fees, loan sizing, leverage, term length, and timing: provided only after Grand Funding reviews the specific transaction. Call for terms: (602) 935-0371.
- Prepayment terms are provided in writing
- This website is not a commitment to lend

- Phone: (602) 935-0371
- Email: Logan@grandfundingllc.com
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/logan.loans/
- Website: https://www.grandfundingllc.com

## Loan Products

- Fix-and-Flip Loans: business-purpose financing for investor purchases and renovations; terms determined after deal review
- Bridge Loans: short-term business-purpose financing for time-sensitive investor acquisitions; terms determined after deal review
- Construction Loans: ground-up new builds and major renovations; draw structure set after project review
- Second Position Loans: a junior lien behind an existing first mortgage on investment property; terms determined after deal review
- Cash-Out Refinance: refinance of existing investment properties; terms determined after deal review

## Frequently Asked Questions

**What is a hard money loan?**
A hard money loan is short-term real estate financing secured by real property. Real estate investors use it for acquisitions, renovations, bridge financing, and equity extraction. Credit, income, experience, and documentation requirements are determined after review of the specific transaction.

**Can I use a Grand Funding loan for my primary residence?**
No. Grand Funding makes business-purpose loans to real estate investors only. Loans are not available for owner-occupied, primary-residence, or consumer purposes.

**How fast can Grand Funding close a loan in Arizona?**
Timing depends on the property, title, and documentation, and is discussed after Grand Funding reviews the specific transaction. Call for terms: (602) 935-0371.

**What types of loans does Grand Funding offer?**
Business-purpose fix-and-flip loans, bridge loans, construction loans, second position loans, and cash-out refinance loans for investment properties. Terms are determined after deal review.

**Do I need to show income or tax returns?**
Grand Funding reviews each transaction individually. Credit, income, experience, and documentation requirements are determined after review of the specific transaction.

**What states does Grand Funding lend in?**
Arizona and California. Arizona coverage includes Phoenix, Scottsdale, Tempe, Mesa, Gilbert, Chandler, Tucson, and statewide. California coverage includes Los Angeles, San Diego, and statewide.

**What is the minimum and maximum loan amount?**
Loan sizing is determined after review. Call for terms: (602) 935-0371.

**What is a second position loan?**
A second position loan (also called a junior lien or second mortgage) is a new loan placed behind an existing first mortgage. The existing first mortgage stays in place. Investors use it to access equity in an investment property without refinancing the first loan.

**What is the difference between a cash-out refinance and a second position loan?**
A cash-out refinance pays off the existing first mortgage and replaces it with a larger new loan — you receive the difference in cash. A second position loan adds a new loan behind your existing first, which remains unchanged. Compare combined payments, fees, and the payoff plan before deciding.

**How do I request a quote from Grand Funding?**
Use the quote request form at grandfundingllc.com/apply, call (602) 935-0371, or email Logan@grandfundingllc.com. Logan reviews every request personally and follows up with terms or questions.

**What is LTV and how does it affect my loan?**
LTV (Loan-to-Value) is the loan amount divided by the property value. Grand Funding determines leverage after reviewing the specific transaction.

**What is ARV?**
ARV stands for After Repair Value — the estimated market value of a property once renovations are complete. Grand Funding reviews comparable sales when evaluating a proposed ARV.

## Grand Funding LLC

Grand Funding LLC offers business-purpose real estate financing for investors in Arizona and California. Call **(602) 935-0371**, email **Logan@grandfundingllc.com**, or use the quote request form to begin a discussion.

## Ideal Borrower Profile

Grand Funding is a fit for:
- Real estate investors with a deal under contract or an investment property to refinance
- Fix-and-flip projects in Arizona or California (acquisition + rehab)
- Bridge financing between a sale and a purchase
- Ground-up construction (residential or small commercial) with a build budget and timeline
- Cash-out refinance on existing investment properties
- Investors who need to move faster than a conventional bank process allows
- Repeat investors who value relationship lending over rate-shopping

Grand Funding is NOT a fit for:
- Owner-occupied, primary-residence, or consumer-purpose loans of any kind
- Borrowers looking for long-term amortizing home financing
- Properties outside Arizona and California

## Why Investors Choose Grand Funding

1. **Direct review**: Logan reviews every request personally and is the contact for the loan.
2. **Transaction-specific**: Credit, income, experience, and documentation requirements are determined after review of the specific transaction.
3. **Real conversations**: Logan picks up the phone. Call for terms: (602) 935-0371.

## Transaction Review

Grand Funding reviews property details, the requested structure, and the proposed exit strategy. Loan sizing, timing, and final terms are provided after review.

## How to Reach Grand Funding

The fastest path is the phone: **(602) 935-0371**. Logan answers calls personally during business hours. If you're calling about a deal already under contract, mention that.

For investors who prefer email: **Logan@grandfundingllc.com**.

The quote request form at **grandfundingllc.com/apply** collects the property, plan, and requested funds so Logan can review the deal.
